--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M5SJQ62SPB7ZA9CC9H91TTB2
+- 01M5QWJGM1679S6CWHFCST7WAN
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '9180'
+title: 'MTP: FoundationModels guided generation (schema and required tools) with the MTP drafter and grammar rollback'
+---
+## What
+Schema output (`runSchemaGeneration`) and required tool calls (`runRequiredToolTurn`) run `GuidedGenerationLoop.run` (Libraries/MLXGuidedGeneration or Libraries/MLXFoundationModels guided files; GuidedGenerationLoop.swift ~112-563). This loop is separate from `generateLoopTask`: it uses a new KV cache, no prompt cache (`carriesNoCache`, MLXLanguageModel.swift ~1666, ~2248), applies an xgrammar bitmask (`applyMaskAndSample` ~531-563) and always takes argmax. Thus guided output is greedy, and speculative sampling is not necessary here.
+
+The matcher is stateful for each token: `computeMask()` (XGrammarBridge.swift ~515) reads the current state, and `commitToken(_:fastForward:)` (~560-665) accepts a token and its forced jump-forward tokens. `rollback(n)` (~698-707) exists, and `n` must include the fast-forward acceptances; only tests use it (RollbackDeterminismTests, ForkIndependenceTests). Forced tokens are fed to the model one at a time (GuidedGenerationLoop.swift ~356-422); the comment at ~387-393 reports an MLX causal SDPA bug with T_q > 1 on a populated cache for Gemma 3.
+
+- [ ] Draft with the MTP drafter, masked by the grammar: get the mask for position 1, take the masked argmax of the drafter logits, `commitToken` it, and get the mask for position 2. Record the number of matcher acceptances (draft + fast-forward) for each draft.
+- [ ] Verify the drafts with one target forward pass, apply the mask of each position to the target logits, and accept while the masked target argmax equals the draft. On a rejection, `rollback` the matcher by the recorded count, commit the target token, and roll back the GDN state with the snapshot slots.
+- [ ] Put the forced fast-forward tokens into the same verify batch (they need no draft and are always accepted), but only for targets where T_q > 1 on a populated cache is proven correct (Qwen35 is; the scripted test must prove it). Keep the one-token feed for other targets.
+- [ ] Use the MTP path only when the target has a drafter; else keep the current loop unchanged.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] For the schemas in the GuidedGeneration tests and a required tool call, the output with MTP is byte-identical to the output without MTP, on the scripted Qwen35 + MTP fixture and on the real Qwen3.8 model.
+- [ ] After a rejected draft, the matcher state equals the state of a run without MTP at the same position (compare the next mask).
+- [ ] Real model: guided JSON generation tok/s with MTP > without MTP (add a case to GuidedGenerationBenchmarkTests).
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/GuidedGenerationMTPTests.swift: equality, matcher rollback with and without fast-forward tokens, mask equality after rejection.
+- [ ] IntegrationTesting/IntegrationTestingTests/MLXFoundationModelsIntegration/GuidedGeneration/GuidedGenerationBenchmarkTests.swift: an MTP case that skips when the MTP head is not local.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests` and the MLXFoundationModelsTests target pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #mtp #qwen38 #foundation-models #guided-generation
\ No newline at end of file
